accounts.name: claimer
docs: Authorises the claim. Never charged for anything, so this may be a
wallet holding exactly zero COOK.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the rent for the claim record. Usually the relayer, which reclaims
it from the sponsor vault in the same transaction.

accounts.name: claim
docs: Creating this account is what makes a second claim impossible.

accounts.name: claimer
docs: Authorises the claim and ends up owning the position. Charged nothing,
so a wallet with zero COOK can do this.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the rent for the claim record and the position.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Owns the position and supplies the deposit itself.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the rent for a first-time position. May be the relayer, so a user
bridging in for the first time is not blocked by rent.

accounts.name: slot_hashes
docs: the full sysvar is too large to deserialize on-chain.

fields.name: relayer
docs: Hot wallet that pays transaction fees. Fee payer only. It is never an
authority over any vault in this program.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new deposits. Withdrawals and harvests stay open.

types.name: EnvelopeClaim
docs: Existence of this account is the proof that a wallet already claimed.
Creating it twice fails at the runtime level, so double claims are
impossible rather than merely checked.

fields.name: into_jar
docs: True when the claim went straight into a jar instead of a wallet.

fields.name: reward_total
docs: Total rewards ever funded into this jar.

fields.name: reward_distributed
docs: Rewards accounted as streamed so far (Proportional only).

fields.name: reward_claimed
docs: Rewards actually paid out.

fields.name: reward_rate
docs: Lamports per second (Proportional only).

fields.name: total_deposited
docs: Principal currently held in the jar vault. This is the TVL figure.

fields.name: acc_reward_per_share
docs: Reward-per-share accumulator, scaled by ACC_PRECISION.

fields.name: entry_count
docs: Entries handed out so far (Lucky only).

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Accumulator checkpoint, scaled by ACC_PRECISION.

fields.name: pending
docs: Settled but not yet transferred.

fields.name: entry_index
docs: Entry number for Lucky jars. Meaningless unless `has_entry`.

types.name: Sponsor
docs: One per sponsor. Sponsors fund their own users' gas rather than drawing from
a shared pool, so nobody can spend someone else's balance.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_REIMBURSEMENT
docs: Hard cap on what the relayer may reclaim per sponsored transaction.
It covers two things the relayer fronts on a user's behalf: the transaction
fee (10,000 lamports observed on Cookie Chain) and the rent for any account
the instruction opens, which is about 3.3M lamports for a position plus a
claim record. The cap is what bounds the damage if the relayer key leaks:
draining a 2,000 COOK vault would take 400,000 separate transactions.
